quote: Shop is a 100% rice-flour (米粉) bakery and bakes no wheat products, so there is no wheat flour on the premises to cross-contaminate.

quote: Sweet/savory bagels use mochi, cheese, bacon, anko, chocolate and nut mix-ins; no soy-sauce-based items reported, but confirm the みたらし (mitarashi) glaze on 焦がしみたらし×チーズ, which traditionally contains soy sauce.

Two list errors to fix: 'mochi' is a misreading of もちもち食感 (a texture), and anko/chocolate are evidenced only on the goguynet article (ほうじ茶×あんこ, ゴマゴマあんこ, ココア×クランベリーチョコ) — bagel-atsume's あんこ/チョコ words are its site-wide tag cloud, not this shop's lineup.

note: Cheese and bacon are on the cited page. 'White chocolate' is not — it comes from goguynet (アールグレイ×ホワイトチョコ). Conclusion (dairy+meat present, no vegan line) holds; vegan_status 'options' is correct.

quote: No documented allergy-handling statement beyond the blanket gluten-free / additive-free claim; owner-operated, so ask directly.

note: Page carries the blanket GF claim and nothing on allergen handling; 無添加 is on bagel-atsume rather than here.

quote: Entire shop is gluten-free by design — 国産米粉100%・無添加 with no wheat baked on site.

note: Verbatim 国産米粉100%・無添加・グルテンフリー confirmed. Trading: opened 7 Nov 2025, Tue & Sun from 12:00, still current. gf_confidence 'options' is defensible — both cited sources are the same launch announcement.

quote: The owner has independently researched and developed vegan, vegetarian, and allergen-conscious dishes, indicating awareness of dietary needs (no documented formal protocol).
found: ビーガン、ベジタリアン、アレルギー対応、食事療法と食事メニューは全てオーナー独自の研究開発。自社開発の玄米麺は全国発送もする。
note: Verbatim match. BUT the same page contradicts vegan_status 'full': おにぎりプレート is 「玄米おにぎり2個といりこと昆布の出汁でとった具だくさんの味噌汁」 — iriko is dried sardine — and the tofu-hamburger salad is dressed 出汁醬油・ポン酢 (wheat soy sauce). Page dated 2021, updated 2023; needs owner resolution.

quote: All menus are prepared without fish, meat, dairy, or wheat, using carefully selected grains and vegetables with minimal additives and pesticides.
found: Tabelog says only 「野菜料理にこだわる、健康・美容メニューあり、ベジタリアンメニューあり」 (EN page: 'Vegetarian options') — nothing about fish/meat/dairy/wheat, additives or pesticides. The real wording is the shop's own pre-renewal site: 「動物性食材不使用／動物性油脂不使用／乳製品／卵不使用／添加物不使用／有機以上の食材・調味料使用／グルテン不使用／地産地消」 plus 「当店のメニューには産地直送、地産地消のオーガニック野菜／玄米／ハーブを使用しています」
http: tabelog 200 via s.tabelog.com iPhone UA; archive 200
note: Repair the URL. Note the live nl-kururu.com was rebuilt 2026-06-15 and this whole-kitchen claim list is GONE from it — the claim now survives only in the archive, so it is stale and should be re-confirmed with the shop.

quote: The kitchen describes its food as additive- and gluten-free (添加物・グルテン不使用), built around organic sprouted brown rice and house-made brown-rice noodles.
found: Current site (renewed 2026-06-15): 「全国初のフードセラピー専門店。独自研究から生まれた『食べるファスティング』は添加物・グルテン不使用で、循環や巡りを良くし…」
method: 1 plain fetch + 3 Wayback for the prior wording
note: SCOPE NARROWED — the quote survives but 添加物・グルテン不使用 now attaches only to the 「食べるファスティング」 product, not to the kitchen as a whole. Sprouted brown rice and 玄米麺 are absent from the current site (they were present at archive 20251207: 玄米おにぎりPlate, 季節の玄米麺, 玄米粉ベジカレー, 発芽玄米ごはん). Also: the site's own Total Therapy cafe KURURU page now reads 「準備中」 — re-check the cafe is actually trading before publishing.

quote: The signature tofu hamburger plate is explicitly noted as suitable for people practicing veganism.
found: 「●豆腐ハンバーグプレート 1738円（税込み価格）ヴィーガンを実践している人も食べれる内容のようです。身体に良さそうでした。」 — a user review on the Tabelog review list, not the main page.
note: 'Explicitly noted' overstates it — this is one diner's impression phrased 「…ようです」, not a shop statement. Corroboration for vegan:full does exist: another reviewer was asked by staff 「ヴィーガンの店ですけどいいですか？」 and a third writes ヴィーガンメニューでグルテンフリーで添加物も使われていない. vegan_status 'full' stands, subject to the iriko-dashi conflict flagged above.

quote: 「すべての商品がグルテンフリー」— all products are gluten-free and no wheat flour is baked on the premises, making wheat cross-contact inherently very low.
found: ・卵、乳製品、白砂糖不使用のヴィーガンスイーツ ・すべての商品がグルテンフリー
note: Quote is verbatim on the cited page. Standing caveat: komeko-palette is a competing rice-flour retailer's listicle covering TWO shops (米粉café 沙羅双樹 and laccola) — keep 沙羅双樹's 米粉100% text from bleeding into laccola's entry. Independent corroboration for shop-wide GF exists on laccola's own site: 「グルテンフリー、卵・乳製品・白砂糖不使用」 and storefront title 「グルテンフリー&ヴィーガンスイーツ laccola-ラッコラ-」.

quote: Some baked goods use oats/oatmeal alongside rice flour; oats are naturally GF but are a common cross-contamination vector unless certified, so highly sensitive celiacs should confirm sourcing.
found: komeko-palette mentions oats nowhere (no オート/オーツ/燕麦 on the page). Oats are real, though: laccola's own storefront carries an オートミールクッキー product category and a 「スパイシーオートミール」 item.
note: Claim is TRUE, citation is wrong — repoint to laccola.base.shop. No certified-GF-oat sourcing statement appears anywhere on the storefront, so the caveat is warranted.

quote: Entire shop is vegan (no eggs, dairy or white sugar), so no animal cross-contact risk.
found: 「グルテンフリー、卵・乳製品・白砂糖不使用」／「植物由来の材料だけで…ラッコラのお菓子たち。」
note: Verbatim. Every storefront item is labelled ◆グルテンフリー&ヴィーガン◆卵・乳製品・白砂糖不使用 with plant-only 原材料 (豆腐／豆乳／米油／米粉). vegan_status 'full' is correct.

quote: No published explicit celiac cross-contamination or allergen-handling protocol beyond the whole-shop gluten-free / plant-based positioning.
found: Page contains only 店名／住所／営業時間／定休日／アクセス plus the tag 「米粉スイーツ専門店」 — no allergen content of any kind.
note: Weak citation: komepan-navi is a bare directory stub, so its silence is not real evidence of absence. Better cite laccola.base.shop, where products carry only 「製造所ではアレルゲン特定原材料等を含む食品を使用しています」 — a shared-facility notice, not a protocol. No 原材料 list names 小麦.

quote: 100% gluten-free, wheat-free and vegan product range — no wheat flour used in the shop at all.
found: 「グルテンフリー、卵・乳製品・白砂糖不使用」 and meta description 「ヴィーガンスイーツショップ laccola－ラッコラ－です。グルテンフリー、卵・乳製品・白砂糖不使用の植物由来の材料にこだわって、焼菓子を中心としたラインナップです。」
note: UNDER-RATED — flagging for re-review. Every item on the shop's own storefront is titled ◆グルテンフリー&ヴィーガン◆ with 米粉(奈良県産ﾋﾉﾋｶﾘ) as the flour and no 小麦 in any 原材料 list; the shop-wide GF claim appears on laccola.com, laccola.base.shop AND komeko-palette. The 2026-08-19 downgrade high→options rested on the premise that 'the shop makes NO blanket all-products-gluten-free claim' — laccola.com's own header and meta description do make a shop-wide グルテンフリー claim, so that premise is factually wrong. Only the uncertified-oat vector genuinely argues against 'high'.

quote: Made without eggs, dairy and refined sugar; rice flour and koji based.
found: 「laccolaでは、すべての商品を植物由来の材料のみで作っています。卵や乳製品、白砂糖を一切使用せず…」／「バレンタインには砂糖不使用の甘酒生チョコレート…変わり甘酒シリーズ」
note: Eggs/dairy/white-sugar and the koji (甘酒／甘糀 waku) line are both on the cited page. 'Rice flour' is NOT — that comes from the storefront 原材料: 米粉(奈良県産ﾋﾉﾋｶﾘ). Almonds and pistachio also feature heavily, so the base is not rice flour alone.

quote: Rice-flour-only chiffon specialist — no wheat flour is baked on premises, so flour-borne cross-contact is inherently low, but no formal celiac CC protocol is published.
found: Cited page supports only the chiffon line: 「『シフォンのお店PUKKU』は、長年のノウハウを活かし、〝小麦粉不使用（グルテンフリー）〟にこだわっています」 and 「米粉100%のグルテンフリーで仕上げられています」 (both about 100年しふぉん). It says nothing about the premises. PUKKU's own minne storefront contradicts the premises claim outright: 「良質な北海道産生乳100%の無調整牛乳・北海道産小麦粉…こだわりの食材を使い、毎日丁寧にお作りしております」 and 「但し材料の一部に、卵・牛乳・小麦を含みますので、アレルギーのある方はご購入を控えていただきますようお願いします」 (allergy label: 卵・乳・小麦・くるみ).
method: 1 plain fetch + the shop's own storefront
note: SAFETY DEFECT — PUKKU bakes with Hokkaido WHEAT FLOUR daily. 'Rice-flour-only' and 'no wheat flour on premises' are false. Wheat lines on its own site: クッキー缶, アイシングクッキー, ガレットブルトンヌ, バターサンドクッキー, いろいろクッキー (minne lists these WITHOUT the 米粉 prefix it uses for 米粉シフォン and 米粉フィナンシェ). Record is filed category GF with gf_confidence 'options' — both need review; this is a mixed wheat + rice-flour kitchen whose own storefront tells wheat-allergic customers not to buy.

quote: Primarily a sweets shop; the café lunch (まんPUKKUランチ) may involve savory seasonings — confirm any soy sauce used is wheat-free (tamari) for celiac lunch guests.
found: 「まんPUKKUランチ 1,200円（税込）」 — the lunch exists; the article says nothing about seasonings.
note: Understated. The shop's own lunch page names 豚のとろとろ角煮, 鶏のから揚げ, 大人のスパイシーから揚げ and バターチキンカレー plus お味噌汁 — karaage is a fried, normally flour-coated, soy-marinated dish and kakuni is soy-sauce braised. That is a fryer plus wheat-soy-sauce kitchen, not 'may involve savory seasonings'. Price is also stale (now ¥1,580).

quote: Not applicable — products contain egg, milk and cream; no vegan line advertised.
found: 「金剛山南麓で育った赤鶏から生まれた新鮮卵をはじめ、良質な北海道産生乳100%の無調整牛乳、九州産米粉、ミネラル豊富なきび砂糖…」 plus 生クリーム on multiple items.
note: Verbatim; vegan_status 'no' is correct. The lunch menu adds pork and chicken.

quote: The 100年しふぉん is explicitly promoted as 米粉100%のグルテンフリー made to give reassurance to customers, but individual allergen handling for café dishes is not documented online.
found: 「奈良で百年以上愛されてきた伝統食材『吉野本葛』と『米飴』を贅沢に使用し、米粉100%のグルテンフリーで仕上げられています」／「アレルギーを気にされる方や健康志向の方にも、安心して美味しいシフォンケーキを楽しんでほしいというお店の思いが込められています」
note: Exact. Scope is the single product 100年しふぉん, which is the correct reading — it must not be generalised to the shop.

quote: Whole chiffon range is 米粉100% / グルテンフリー with no wheat baking on site.
found: The official site says only 「奈良市西登美ヶ丘にある米粉シフォンケーキ専門店です。cafeスペースでは、ランチやモーニングもお召し上がりいただけます。」 — no 米粉100%, no グルテンフリー anywhere on it. The same site's nav sells クッキー缶／アイシングクッキー／ガレットブルトンヌ／メレンゲクッキー／シフォンラスク, and its minne storefront names 北海道産小麦粉 as a headline ingredient with a 卵・牛乳・小麦 allergy warning.
note: SAFETY DEFECT — the strongest GF sentence on this record is not on the page it cites, and the 'no wheat baking on site' half is affirmatively false in the shop's own words. Rewrite to: the 米粉 chiffon line (and 米粉フィナンシェ) is wheat-flour-free by recipe, but the shop bakes wheat cookies daily in the same kitchen.

quote: Signature cake uses traditional Nara 吉野本葛 and 米飴 instead of refined/wheat-based ingredients.
found: 「生地に配合されているのは、葛の根から抽出される高級食材〝吉野本葛〟です」／「もう一つの主役は、米を原料にした天然甘味料〝米飴〟です…精製されていないため身体に優しく」
note: Exact match; both ingredients confirmed and both are gluten-free.

quote: This is a wheat-flour bakery using 100% domestic wheat for its main lineup; a gluten-free rice-flour bread is offered but no separate workspace, equipment or cross-contamination controls are documented, so cross-contact with wheat is likely.
found: 「北海道産の国産小麦を100％使い、『乳化剤』や『イーストフード』や『改良剤』など合成添加物を一切使われていない無添加です」／「グルテンが気になる方には、米粉を100％使ったグルテンフリーの米粉パンも用意されています」
note: Both halves verbatim, and the article documents no separation of any kind. gf_confidence 'options' is the honest bucket here — one rice-flour bread inside an all-wheat bakery.

quote: Signature breads contain butter, eggs and dairy and are baked alongside all other products; no vegan-segregated handling is described.
found: 「リピート率No.1『焙煎玄米塩バターロール』…玄米の風味、岩塩、バターのバランスが抜群」／「『さくさくメロンパン』…注文後にホイップクリームやアイスをサンドするスイーツ系まで」／「ガラス越しにパン工房も見えて」
note: Butter and dairy (butter roll, whipped cream, ice cream, 粒あんバター) are explicit; a single visible workshop supports 'baked alongside'. 'Eggs' is NOT named on the page — implied by メロンパン only. Stronger animal vectors the claim misses: 「みあとパン（サバの塩焼き）」 (grilled mackerel) and 「めんたいバター」 (mentaiko/pollock roe) — fish, not just dairy. vegan_status 'limited' stands.

quote: All breads are made with natural fermentation and without synthetic additives such as emulsifiers, yeast food or dough improvers, using 100% domestic Hokkaido wheat.
found: 「北海道産の国産小麦を100％使い、添加物を一切使わず、天然酵母で焼き上げています」／「『乳化剤』や『イーストフード』や『改良剤』など合成添加物を一切使われていない無添加です」
note: Verbatim on both counts; corroborated independently by tabizine (「北海道産小麦を使った無添加生地を使用し、乳化剤やイーストフードは不使用」).

quote: A gluten-free rice-flour bread is available for customers who are concerned about gluten.
found: 「グルテンが気になる方には、米粉を100％使ったグルテンフリーの米粉パンも用意されています」
note: Verbatim. Note the wording targets 「グルテンが気になる方」 (people who are concerned about gluten), not celiacs — vocabulary is not evidence either way, but no handling claim is attached to it.

quote: Small home-style kitchen with no documented dedicated gluten-free preparation or allergen separation; even though no wheat flour is used in the curries, fermented and seasoning ingredients may still introduce gluten or cross-contact, so coeliacs should ask about each day's specific dishes.
found: 「ぬくもりと懐かしさを感じる古民家で営む小さなカレー店。…出汁・塩・発酵を大切にしたカレーは…また化学調味料と小麦粉を使わない体へのやさしさも溢れています」
note: Verbatim for 小麦粉不使用 and 発酵; page carries no allergen or separation statement, matching the negative claim. The 発酵 caveat is well placed — 発酵 in a Japanese curry kitchen normally means miso/shoyu, both wheat vectors.

quote: Curries are built on dashi and the rotating menu features chicken, seafood and egg, so vegan diners cannot assume shared pots or stocks are plant-based — confirm the bean curry and its dashi before ordering.
found: 「カレーは週替わりで、この日は、チキンと酒粕のカレー、タコイカ辛カレー、豆カレーの3種類でした」／「スパイス半熟玉子（税込100円）のトッピングもありました」／「カレーが3種類、副菜が3種類、ご飯のワンプレートです」
note: Chicken, octopus/squid, bean curry and the egg topping are all verbatim. 'Built on dashi' is not on this page — that is narakko's 「出汁・塩・発酵を大切にした」. Stronger point the claim misses: the only meal sold is a 3種あいがけ ONE-PLATE (all three curries served together, ¥1,100-1,250), so plate-level contact between the bean curry and the chicken/seafood curries is structural, not avoidable by ordering. vegan_status 'limited' is right; arguably it should read 'ask' rather than imply a reliably vegan option.

quote: The kitchen explicitly does not use wheat flour or chemical seasonings, relying instead on dashi, salt, fermentation and spices — a meaningful starting point for gluten-sensitive diners (though not a verified celiac-safe environment).
found: 「出汁・塩・発酵を大切にしたカレーは素材の旨みとスパイスの刺激もたっぷり感じられる一皿。…また化学調味料と小麦粉を使わない体へのやさしさも溢れています」
note: Verbatim, and the hedge in the claim is correctly placed. Identity/trading confirmed at 奈良市法蓮町1232, 11:00-15:00, 不定休 across narakko (2024) and naralunch (2022).

quote: The signature gateau au chocolat is made with no wheat flour and no rice flour, so the core product is naturally gluten-free by recipe.
found: section heading 「小麦粉を使わない（グルテンフリー）」 followed by 「…かるくてなめらかな味わいをお楽しみ頂くために、小麦粉、米粉、ベーキングパウダーといった粉類は一切、使用しておりません。手際だけで『ふんわり、しっとり』と焼き上げています。」
note: Verbatim and unusually explicit — flour of ANY kind is excluded, not just wheat. Trading confirmed: 奈良市餅飯殿町12 夢Cube D号室, 10:00-19:00, 木曜定休, phone live on site.

quote: A local news feature independently confirms the cake is made without wheat or rice flour and is naturally gluten-free.
found: 「店主が研究に10年以上を費やしてたどり着いたのが、小麦粉や米粉を使わない、山椒を使ったガトーショコラとのことでした。」
note: Genuine independent corroboration of the no-wheat/no-rice-flour recipe. Caveat: goguynet never uses the words グルテンフリー — that inference is ours (correct, but it is an inference). POSSIBLE UNDER-RATING: this is a single-product 専門店 whose only product contains no flour at all, confirmed by the shop AND a local news visit, so there is nothing wheat-bearing in the shop to cross-contaminate; gf_confidence 'options' looks low for that. What is genuinely missing is any statement about the premises/equipment, and 15-year-shelf-life claims aside, the cake contains 生クリーム/バター so vegan_status 'no' is correct.

quote: Not a dedicated gluten-free facility: wheat (ancient spelt) is used for the popular rum-raisin sandwich sable, so rice-flour items are baked in a kitchen that also handles wheat. Celiac visitors should ask which items are rice-flour-based and weigh cross-contact risk.
found: 「一番人気は、動物性食材不使用の『ラムレーズンサンド』。滋賀県産の古代小麦スペルトをベースに焼いたサブレに、オーガニックカシューナッツとカカオバターのクリーム、ラムレーズンがサンドされた…」
note: Verbatim, and spelt is correctly treated as wheat. UNDERSTATED though: wheat is not confined to that one sable. The note.com product list shows 「古代小麦クッキー（古代小麦）」 as a separate standing line alongside 「ラムレーズンサンド（古代小麦）」, and Somi's own site headlined 「veganレシピで古代小麦や無農薬米粉のお菓子を作っています」 — ancient wheat is one of the shop's two base flours, not an exception. Also add the oat vector: 「クリームサンドクッキー（オートミール）」 and 「タルト（オートミール）各種」, with no certified-GF-oat statement anywhere.

quote: Entire shop is plant-based, so there is no animal-product cross-contact concern; all sweets and the coffee program are vegan.
found: 「今回は、週替わりで20種類ほどのヴィーガンスイーツを販売されているヴィーガンスイーツ専門店『Somi sweets&coffee』」 plus an all-vegan item list (cashew/soy-milk creams, no dairy variants offered).
